title: Fee-Standing Goodwill Decision Table, Builder Extended Rate Lock
content:
A buyer who paid the Builder Extended Rate Lock upfront fee in full earns goodwill on a builder-delay waiver, more when the fee was paid promptly.

**Rule.** The upfront fee due is the term's upfront fee percent of the loan amount on the lock, rounded half up to the cent, with a floor of the term's minimum upfront fee, and the fee lag is the calendar days from the lock request date to the latest lock fee payment on the lock ledger. Where the lock fee payments on the ledger add up to at least the upfront fee due and the fee lag is 1 day or fewer, the goodwill is USD 100.00; where they add up to at least the upfront fee due and the fee lag is longer than 1 day, it is USD 50.00; otherwise it is zero. The goodwill is added to the waiver after the waiver percent of the extension charge has been rounded to the cent.

## Upfront fee due by term

| Lock term | Upfront fee percent | Minimum upfront fee |
|---|---|---|
| 60-Day Standard Lock | 0.000 | USD 0.00 |
| 90-Day Lock | 0.000 | USD 0.00 |
| 120-Day Extended Lock | 0.250 | USD 500.00 |
| 180-Day Extended Lock | 0.500 | USD 1000.00 |
| 270-Day Build Lock | 1.000 | USD 2000.00 |
| 360-Day Build Lock | 1.500 | USD 3000.00 |

## Decision table

| Payments add up to at least the fee due | Fee lag | Goodwill |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 0 or 1 day | USD 100.00 |
| Yes | 2 days or more | USD 50.00 |
| No | any | none |

Where the ledger carries no lock fee payment there is no latest payment and no fee lag, and the goodwill is zero.

## Example (hypothetical inputs)

A 180-Day Extended Lock with a loan amount of USD 300000.00: 0.500 percent is 1500.00, above the USD 1000.00 minimum, so the fee due is USD 1500.00. Requested 4 March; payments of USD 1500.00 posted 5 March: lag 1, goodwill USD 100.00. Posted 7 March instead: lag 3, goodwill USD 50.00. Only USD 1000.00 paid: goodwill none.
